name: Role titles
description: Occupational / responder role(s) the person holds (doctor, nurse, paramedic, fire officer, coordinator, etc.). E21 Person classified by E55 Type via P2 has type. Repeatable.

name: Contact handle
description: Single free-text contact string (phone, email, radio callsign).

name: Primary site
description: Site resource where the person is normally stationed.

name: Keyholder for
description: Building(s) this person is a keyholder / responsible custodian for (the responder's 'who do I call' link). Repeatable; derived from employer ∘ occupancy.

name: Employer
description: The organisation this person works for — the employment link that connects people into the org/building web.

name: Duty status
description: Designated roster / availability status (on call, on duty, off duty, unavailable) — the standing contactability status, NOT real-time presence. E21 Person classified by E55 Type via P2 has type.
